principles: verify the immutable review bundle and hash-chained review ledger before ingestion
exclude reviewer identity from Agent-visible feedback
bind every feedback campaign to the feedback manifest digest and review ledger head
never mutate or resume the source frozen campaign with newly revealed human feedback

routes.human_clarification: block geometry until missing requirements are supplied
routes.agent_repair: provide prior human findings as evidence in a new reconstruction campaign
routes.system_improvement: queue the finding outside the fixed sample run
routes.evaluation_only: retain the adjudication without changing Agent behavior
